newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian minister resigns over child deaths at show.
newsitem.headline: Latvian minister resigns over child deaths at show.

text.p: Latvian Interior Minister Dainis Turlais resigned on Monday after eight children died at the weekend during a firefighting show, a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
Prime Minister Adris Shkele, who rushed back from a holiday to head a government commission examining the cause of the tragedy, accepted Turlais's resignation.

The eight children, aged five to 16, plunged 20 metres (yards) to their death before hundreds of horrified spectators on Saturday when the basket they were in fell from a crane during an exhibition of firefighting techniques and equipment.
Twenty-two other people were injured, at least 10 seriously, in the accident in the small town of Talsi, 100 kms (60 miles) north-west of the capital Riga. All but one of the injured were children.
Latvian President Guntis Ulmanis visited the site of the accident on Monday.
The interior ministry says there was criminal negligence and has arrested the crane's two operators.
Monday was declared a national day of mourning in Latvia and flags with black ribbons were flown on buildings across the country.
The prosecutor's office said it would release the results of its technical analysis of the crane later on Monday or Tuesday.
Much of the firefighting and rescue service equipment in the states of the former Soviet Union is old and worn out, and cash-strapped local governments lack the funds to buy replacements.
